faq.question: Can complete beginners without prior editing or filmmaking experience enroll in this course?
faq.answer: Yes. Professional Video Editing is structured from foundational principles. Month 1 begins with visual storytelling grammar, shot sizes, continuity rules, and computer workspace setup before advancing into timeline mechanics. No prior experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or video theory is required.

faq.question: What is the total duration, guided hours, and weekly time commitment for this program?
faq.answer: The program spans exactly 4 Months (16 Academic Weeks) comprising 160 Guided Production Hours across 11 structured industry modules. Students should plan for 10 hours of structured guided instruction per week, plus 6 to 8 hours of independent classroom lab drills and project editing.

faq.question: How deeply is Adobe Premiere Pro covered in the curriculum?
faq.answer: Adobe Premiere Pro 26.5 serves as your primary non-linear timeline editing engine across Modules 02 and 03 (44 guided hours) plus ongoing application in Modules 07–11. You master project setup, proxy pipelines, 3-point editing, ripple/roll trimming, multicam switching, speed ramping, Essential Graphics, and export presets.

faq.question: How is DaVinci Resolve 21 taught, and what specific pages are covered?
faq.answer: DaVinci Resolve 21 receives a dedicated 24-hour deep dive in Module 05. You master the Cut and Edit pages for rapid assembly, XML conforming from Premiere, video scopes (Waveform, Vectorscope, Histogram), Log-to-Rec.709 normalization via CST nodes, Lift/Gamma/Gain primaries, 6-node tree architectures, Power Windows, qualifiers, and the Deliver page.

faq.question: Why is Adobe Photoshop included, and what lessons are taught?
faq.answer: Modern video editors are routinely required to prepare their own graphics. Module 04 dedicates 16 guided hours to Photoshop: raster resolution, Smart Objects, Levels/Curves, Camera Raw filtering, precision selection tools (Pen Tool, Select Subject, Select and Mask), and non-destructive layer hierarchies.

faq.question: What practical video graphics and thumbnail projects are created in Photoshop?
faq.answer: In Module 04, you design a complete 6-piece commercial graphic package: high-CTR YouTube thumbnails (<2MB) with bold typography and facial contrast enhancement, product advertising key visuals, transparent lower-third plates (PNG-24 with alpha), 9:16 expanded backgrounds using Generative Expand, and multi-layer PSD files imported directly into Premiere Pro.

faq.question: What Adobe After Effects skills are taught, and what are the boundaries of the motion module?
faq.answer: Module 08 provides 10 hours of editor-focused motion design: composition settings, transform keyframing, Graph Editor speed curve easing, shape layer Trim Paths, kinetic title cards, lower thirds, logo reveals, and packaging responsive MOGRT templates for Premiere Pro. The course explicitly excludes advanced VFX, 3D character rigging, multi-layer CGI, and complex expressions.

faq.question: How is audio post-production taught across Adobe Audition and DaVinci Resolve Fairlight?
faq.answer: Module 06 dedicates 16 guided hours to production audio engineering: spectral noise restoration in Adobe Audition (erasing sirens and clicks with the Healing Brush), dialogue leveling, 6-band parametric EQ, dynamics compression, and multi-track DAW mixing inside DaVinci Resolve Fairlight with submix buses and broadcast loudness normalization (-14 LUFS online / -24 LUFS broadcast).

faq.question: How is short-form vertical video editing (Reels, Shorts, TikTok) covered?
faq.answer: Module 07 teaches high-retention short-form editing: analyzing retention curves, engineering 0-to-3-second hooks, inserting pattern interrupts every 2 to 4 seconds (scale pops, punch-ins, SFX), styling dynamic word-by-word animated captions, and re-framing footage into vertical 9:16 while adhering to mobile UI safe zones.

faq.question: How is long-form YouTube editing structured in the curriculum?
faq.answer: Module 07 covers long-form YouTube editing: structuring 8-to-20 minute videos using narrative A-roll spines, B-roll contextual layering, chapter segments, lower thirds, on-screen graphic callouts, and aligning the opening 5 seconds with the Photoshop thumbnail promise to maintain high Average View Duration (AVD).

faq.question: What documentary and interview editing workflows are taught?
faq.answer: Documentary and interview editing forms the core of Project 01 and Modules 01, 02, and 06: transcribing rushes, building narrative selects, paper editing, hiding cuts with J-cuts and L-cuts, intercutting contextual B-roll to eliminate talking-head fatigue, matching multi-cam angles, and mixing dialogue to -14 LUFS.

faq.question: What specific AI-assisted editing workflows are taught in Premiere Pro and Resolve?

The 8-Month (320h) Flagship program is a comprehensive master qualification that adds deep After Effects 2D/3D kinetic animation, Mocha AE planar tracking, VFX rotoscoping/compositing, Blender 3D product integration, and frontier generative AI filmmaking (Google Flow, Runway Gen-3).

faq.question: How does this course differ from the 3-month AI Video Editing Professional course?
faq.answer: AI Video Editing Professional (3 Months, 120h) is a rapid, social-first program focused on mobile formats, lightweight AI NLE tools, and automated synthetic content. Professional Video Editing (4 Months, 160h) is an agency-grade craft program focused on dual-engine mastery (Premiere Pro + DaVinci Resolve 21), professional audio restoration, commercial Photoshop graphics, and broadcast delivery.
